scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: node frontend/node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings backend/src backend/tests frontend/src frontend/tests
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run format:check
